Normalise a distance-column oracle result to a masked length-N vector

Source: R/farfirst.R
dot-DistColumn.Rd

The user's colFn(i) may either report the self-distance (a length-N vector, position i ignored) or omit it (a length-N - 1 vector of the distances to the other elements, in index order). Either way this returns a length-N numeric vector with position i set to -Inf, so the downstream which.max() / pmin.int() never re-select i. The mask invariant for the oracle path lives here, not in the callers.

Usage

.DistColumn(colFn, i, N)

Arguments

colFn

Column oracle; see FarFirst().

i

Integer 1-based index whose distance column is requested.

N

Integer element count.

Value

Numeric vector of length N, masked to -Inf at position i.
